R7AG-bear-backcountry-0002.name: 1.9 km NW of Wasi Lake
R7AG-bear-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AG-bear-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Finlay-Osilinka FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2017 (9 years old), 240 m E: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2023 (fire G60666), 290 m NE: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
Unnamed wetland 60 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 143 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.13396, -125.09578, pull off on Finlay-Osilinka FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.8 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 698 m, about 185 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m N of the spot at 1,317 m (56.0838, -125.10885). Water: unnamed wetland 160 m S (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-38, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AG-bear-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-38: about 298 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.02 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
